method.town_selection: Census 2024 Gazetteer incorporated places with NAME ending in 'town' and FUNCSTAT 'A'; select 10 per state at equal intervals over GEOID-sorted eligible towns. Not a random or need-weighted sample.
method.geospatial_measure: Great-circle (haversine) miles from Census geographic representative point to the nearest and third-nearest HRSA Health Center Service Delivery Sites in the search region.
method.cluster: Custom deterministic Lloyd K-means (k=3), population-standardized nearest and third-nearest distances; centers seeded from sorted feature-score quantiles. Labels ordered by nearest-clinic mean. No medical need inference.
method.coverage: Only HRSA-supported service-delivery sites, not all clinics, hospitals, pharmacies or providers. Distances are not driving distances.
method.caveat: Results are screening indicators and do not validate healthcare shortages, patient-level access, or care-kit distribution. QGIS-compatible GeoJSON output; analysis is performed in JavaScript, not QGIS.

interpretation: HRSA-supported service-delivery-site distances only; includes special-purpose and school/mobile sites; not driving distance or aid-kit allocation.
